name: Sweet 'n' Salty Marshmallow Treats with Popcorn, Crackers, Pretzels & Peanuts

instructions.primary_message: Line the bottom and sides of a large baking dish with parchment paper and set aside.
Place butter in a large pot and melt over medium-low heat.
Add mini marshmallows to the pot and heat, stirring constantly, until melted and combined with the butter, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add popcorn, crackers, pretzel sticks, and peanuts to the pot, then stir until thoroughly combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
5 cups popcorn, salted
1 ½ cups cheddar cheese crackers
1 ½ cups pretzel sticks
1 cup peanuts, honey roasted

instructions.primary_message: Pour popcorn mixture into the prepared baking dish and, using the back of a metal spoon, spread into the sides, forming an even layer. Set aside to cool, about 1 hour (it will firm up as it cools).
Transfer cooled marshmallow treats to a cutting board. Peel away the parchment paper, then cut into 24 squares.
Arrange marshmallow squares on a plate and serve. Enjoy!
